# Manual verification of the grammar derivation
# Grammar:
# S -> A
# A -> B | '<' A '>'
# B -> 'per' D | '[' B ']' | C
# C -> D
# D -> E
# E -> F | 'coach'
# F -> 'hotel'

# Derivation of "[ [ per hotel ] ]":
# S -> A -> B -> '[' B ']' -> '[' '[' B ']' ']' -> '[' '[' 'per' D ']' ']' -> '[' '[' 'per' E ']' ']' -> '[' '[' 'per' F ']' ']' -> '[' '[' 'per' 'hotel' ']' ']'

# Derivation of "< < per hotel > >":
# S -> A -> '<' A '>' -> '<' '<' A '>' '>' -> '<' '<' B '>' '>' -> '<' '<' 'per' D '>' '>' -> '<' '<' 'per' E '>' '>' -> '<' '<' 'per' F '>' '>' -> '<' '<' 'per' 'hotel' '>' '>'

# Both are valid. Let's pick one with 6+ tokens.
# "[ [ per hotel ] ]" = 6 tokens
# "< < per hotel > >" = 6 tokens

# Let's also try "< < [ per hotel ] > >" = 8 tokens
# S -> A -> '<' A '>' -> '<' '<' A '>' '>' -> '<' '<' B '>' '>' -> '<' '<' '[' B ']' '>' '>' -> '<' '<' '[' 'per' D ']' '>' '>' -> '<' '<' '[' 'per' 'hotel' ']' '>' '>'
